title: Personlig assistent inom EILA på daglig verksamhet i Ängelholm
description:
Är du vår nya assistent vi letar efter?

OM JOBBET

Vi söker en personlig assistent till daglig verksamhet till en av våra medlemmar, en 46-årig kvinna med diagnosen autism samt intellektuell funktionsnedsättning. Vår medlem saknar tal och har synnedsättning och kommunicerar med hjälp av bilder (pictogram) och kroppsspråk. Rutiner är mycket viktiga för vår medlem.

Du ska stötta vår medlem under hennes arbetstid på daglig verksamhet i Ängelholm. Arbetsuppgifterna består av att ge medlemmen stöd och tillsyn i alla aktiviteter som sker på daglig verksamhet men även att vara behjälplig med personlig hygien, toabesök, kommunikation och följa med på aktiviteter. Medlemmen gillar musik, att fika på stan och äta ute. Hon tycker dessutom om att bada och det är bra om du känner dig trygg i vattnet.

VEM ÄR DU?

Med tanke på medlemmens funktionsvariation är det viktigt att du som söker behärskar det svenska språket väl, är rak och tydlig i din kommunikation samt har förmågan att kunna sätta gränser.

Erfarenhet av tecken som stöd samt kunskap inom autismspektrat är meriterande. Du som assistent kommer att få hjälp och vägledning under din inskolning samt i arbetet från kollegor och anhöriga som alltid finns nära till hands. Vi önskar att du ser långsiktigt på ditt arbete.

Vi ser att du som söker denna tjänst är en ansvarsfull kvinna som är trygg i dig själv och inte är rädd för utmaningar. Vidare ser vi att du är en självgående person som har lätt för att ta egna initiativ för vad som behöver göras i och runt assistansen. Du ska också vara bra på att samarbeta med föräldrarna/god man och med daglig verksamhets personal och vara lyhörd för deras arbetssätt. Vi söker dig som är positiv och lugn, har stort tålamod och som vill satsa för att göra ett bra jobb!

Du som söker skall dessutom ej vara allergisk mot pälsdjur då hund och häst finns med runt medlemmen.

Körkort och tillgång till bil är ett stort plus. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska eller personlig assistent med erfarenhet eller har annan likvärdig utbildning.

Arbetet finns i Ängelholm.

VI ERBJUDER

God introduktion i arbetet erbjuds av arbetsgivaren. Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling erbjuds enligt individuell utvecklingsplan. Det är viktigt för oss att du ska känna dig välkommen för du blir ju vår ambassadör ute.

Med detta arbetet får du ett meningsfullt jobb där du blir viktig på riktigt.

Arbetstiderna är förlagda på dagtid vardagar, 8-15.30. Inga röda dagar. Tjänsten är så länge uppdraget varar och är på ca 90 %.

Vi använder oss av det digitala schemaläggnings- och tidsredovisningsystemet Aiai vilket innebär att du ska vara datorvan.

Utdrag från polisens belastningsregister krävs för att arbeta inom verksamhetsområdet enligt LSS.

VILKA ÄR EILA?

Vi startade vår verksamhet i februari 1995 i Ängelholm och nu finns vi på olika orter i Skåne.

Vi är en ideell förening utan vinstintresse för personer med olika funktionsvariationer och som har rätt till personlig assistans enligt LSS - Lagen om stöd och service.

Vi har idag 20 medlemmar / brukare med olika funktionsvariationer där drygt 140 anställda arbetar i olika anställningsformer och flera brukare är på väg in i vår verksamhet. Vi har kollektivavtal med Kommunal. De flesta av assistenterna är rekryterade ”utifrån”, men vi har också anhöriga som är anställda som personliga assistenter.

EILA fungerar som intressegrupp för medlemmarna och har helhetsansvar för deras assistans och för all personal. Eila är anslutna till kollektivavtalet mellan Fremia och Kommunal.

EILAs värdegrund bygger på:

- Kvalitet och trygghet

- Personligt inflytande

- Frihet under ansvar

- Solidaritet

Vi har dörren alltid öppen för nya medlemmar och nya medarbetare!

Ansökningar behandlas löpande och tillträde av tjänst önskas ske omgående eller efter överenskommelse. Tjänsten kan komma att bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag, så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Välkommen till Kooperativet Eila - det lilla kooperativet utan vinstintresse! Läs mer på www.eila.se

title: Director, Revenue Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
This position is responsible for applying professional knowledge to analyze financial information across all aspects of the patient revenue cycle and for preparing a wide range of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including those required for regulatory compliance. The role also includes maintaining master files and billing fee schedules.


REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

The position reports to the VP of Revenue Cycle


ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

While living and demonstrating our Core Values, the Director of Revenue Analytics, Reporting, & Strategy will:

  • Work collaboratively with the VP of Revenue Cycle to facilitate reporting requirements for the monthly TWC – Revenue Cycle Management Dashboard creation.
  • Responsible for creation and analysis of monthly productivity reports outlining visits, receipts, and charges per provider in conjunction with the VP of Revenue Cycle.
  • Working with VP of Revenue Cycle, ensure the appropriate information is maintained and reconciled to the general ledger to record, measure, value and report on patient service revenue, receivables and related collections and allowances.
  • Streamline month-end Medent reports used by the billing team to address claim rejections and accounts receivable.
  • Responsible for preparing and submitting monthly visit data reports and VTO metrics to the Finance department.
  • Assist the VP of Revenue Cycle in preparing regulatory reports, including the annual Medicare Cost Report, UDS visit measures, Medicaid Wrap-Around report, and other required submissions.
  • Responsible for annual maintenance of billing fee schedule for determination of consistency with local pricing based on Optum’s suggested pricing guidelines for locality.
  • Responsible for maintenance of CPT codes, including adding, updating and deleting codes annually based on current AMA/insurance guidelines.
  • Responsible for maintenance of CPT, Insurance, and Provider Master File setup in conjunction with the EHR team.
  • Responsible for maintenance of other Master Files as assigned.
  • Coordinate with the enrollment team on new provider setups to ensure proper release of insurance claims from the Medent system.
  • Manage outstanding accounts receivable. Parties which may be contacted to resolve an outstanding balance include but are not limited to patients, responsible parties, insurance carriers, case managers, employers, referring physician, attorneys and facility personnel
  • Make all necessary corrections in the billing system. Research and resolve claims rejected by payer. Decide if accounts can’t be paid by the insurance company and summarize for review with the VP Controller Revenue cycle.
  • Identify billing and coverage concerns. Communicate with billing and front office staff regarding billing requirements not being met
  • Answer patient and facility questions about account balance and status of payment. Decide if patient balance is refusal to pay or inability to pay, so the account can be added to a fee waiver request by the VP Controller Revenue Cycle)
  • Responsible for triaging workload and prioritizing tasks through proper utilization of staff resources
  • Identify, correct and communicate facility errors to appropriate parties involved and produce corrective action plans accordingly
  • Identify and communicate payment trends to the Accounts Receivable & Collections Manager, related to payers, CPT codes, diagnosis codes, etc.
  • Approve outstanding credit balances and requests for refunds
  • Along with Director of Revenue Cycle, develop a strategy the team will use to reach goals and maintain high level of productivity
  • Create reports to update the organization on Billing Department progress
  • Develops policies and procedures regarding all front-end revenue cycle processes including insurances, copay collection, payment plans, Sliding Fee, Outreach and Enrollment
  • Develop trainings to ensure proper co-pay collection at the level of the front desk. Further, partner with operational leadership to develop co-pay collection accountability
  • Works closely with the credentialing team to ensure targets are met for providers to meet timely filing and reduce the rate of claim rejections
  • Meets with payor representatives and is knowledgeable of contractual agreements with regards to reimbursement models
  • Serve as Billing Department representative at clinical huddles, didactics and other clinical meetings
  • Serve as Billing Department representative at monthly, organizational-wide Department Compliance meetings
  • Assist with special project reporting out of the Medent system, by gathering the data in excel and manipulating it for its specific use.
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.

title: Servitør
description:
I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?
Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss😎

Som servitør er du stjerna på gulvet i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater.


Hva er suksessoppskriften?
Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på🤩


Det er en fordel dersom du:

  • Har erfaring fra restaurant eller service

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har en lidenskap for salg og gjesteopplevelser

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.


Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢


Har du spørsmål er du hjertelig velkommen til å kontakt med restauranteier Morten Libekk Amrud på 46422636/morten.amrud@sabrurasushi.no.

title: Senior Provider Claims Dispute Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Zing Health is a tech-enabled insurance company making Medicare Advantage the best it can be for those 65-and-over. Zing Health has a community-based approach that recognizes the importance of the social determinants of health in keeping individuals and communities healthy. Zing Health aims to return the physician and the member to the center of the health care equation. Members receive individualized assistance to make their transition to Zing Health as easy as possible. Zing Health offers members the ability to personalize their plans, access to facilities designed to help them better meet their healthcare needs and a dedicated care team. For more information on Zing Health, visit www.myzinghealth.com

SUMMARY DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Provider Claims Dispute Specialist is responsible for the timely, accurate, and compliant resolution of complex provider disputes related to claims adjudication, reimbursement, coding, authorization decisions, and benefit application. This role serves as a subject matter expert for provider dispute resolution policies, CMS requirements, reimbursement methodologies, and provider contract interpretation. The position independently investigates escalated and regulatory-sensitive disputes, processes necessary claim adjustments and overpayment recoveries, conducts root cause and financial impact analyses, develops dispute reporting, and partners across the organization to improve claims accuracy, provider experience, operational performance, and compliance outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for provider dispute resolution policies, CMS requirements, and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Provide guidance and consultation to Claims Operations, Provider Services, Configuration, and Compliance teams regarding dispute resolution issues.
  • Interpret provider contracts, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements to support complex dispute determinations.

Complex Provider Dispute Resolution

  • Independently investigate and resolve escalated, high-dollar, highly complex, and regulatory-sensitive provider disputes.
  • Perform comprehensive payment reviews involving contract interpretation, authorization determinations, coding analysis, and benefit application.
  • Respond to complex provider inquiries regarding claims adjudication and payment determinations.
  • Ensure disputes are resolved accurately and within applicable regulatory and organizational timeframes.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of dispute research, determinations, correspondence, claim adjustments, recoveries, and related tracking activities.

Analytics and Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain dispute trending reports and dashboards.
  • Analyze dispute volume, root causes, financial impact, provider patterns, payment trends, and recurring operational issues.
  • Identify payment errors, process gaps, training needs, and system configuration issues; escalate findings and support corrective action.
  • Contribute findings and recommendations to leadership and present information when requested to help reduce dispute volume and improve operational performance.

Regulatory Expertise and Compliance

  • Maintain advanced knowledge of CMS, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and applicable state regulations affecting claims payment disputes.
  • Conduct regulatory reviews and support implementation of regulatory changes impacting provider dispute processes.
  • Apply applicable compliance requirements, including HIPAA, CMS, and state-specific requirements, when reviewing and resolving disputes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives designed to improve claims accuracy, provider experience, operational efficiency, and compliance outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Configuration, Provider Network, Provider Services, Quality, Compliance, Claims Operations, and IT teams to implement corrective actions.
  • Provide dispute-related expertise to support operational projects and process improvements.

Audit and Financial Accountability

  • Participate in dispute-related audit activities and serve as a subject matter resource, in partnership with other responsible stakeholders, during internal, external, CMS, and state regulatory audits.
  • Identify and quantify financial impacts resulting from payment inaccuracies and dispute trends.
  • Assist with audit requests, documentation, research, and follow-up activities related to provider disputes.

title: Yöohjaaja, Lastensuojeluyksikkö Metsätähti
description:
Meillä Metsätähden erityisyksikössä eletään lasten ja nuorten kanssa heidän ainutkertaisia elämänvaiheitaan. Nyt meillä olisi paikka juuri sinulle päästä osaksi huippu tiimiä, missä meillä ohjaajilla on aito halu luoda meidän lapsille ja nuorille itsensä näköistä tulevaisuutta.

Metsätähti on Lohjan Muijalassa sijaitseva lastensuojelun erityisyksikkö. Lastensuojeluyksikössä on erikoisosaamista etenkin käytöksellään vahvasti oireilevien, kiintymyssuhteissaan traumatisoituneiden ja psyykkisesti oireilevien lasten hoitoon ja kasvatukseen.

Nyt haemme iloista ja ammattitaitoista ohjaajaa sijaisuuteen vuoden 2027 loppuun saakka meille Metsätähteen tekemään pääasiassa yövuoroja.


Millainen työ sinua odottaa?

Ohjaajana tuet ja kannustat lapsia ja nuoria arjen haasteissa sekä osallistut lapsen hoidon ja kasvatuksen arviointiin. Arjessa olet lapsille ja nuorille turvallinen ja luotettava aikuinen, joka huolehtii heidän perustarpeistaan. Työn lähtökohtana on asiakkaan kuuleminen, kunnioittava kohtelu sekä osallisuuden tukeminen. Työtä tehdään aina tiiviissä yhteistyössä huoltajien, lähiverkoston, koulutoimen, hoitotahon ja sosiaaliviranomaisten kanssa. Työ on pääasiassa yötyötä ja palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n palkkaluokkien G22-24 mukaisesti (2460,27-2990,35€).

Sinua odottaa työ, missä yksikään päivä ei koskaan ole samanlainen! Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen työn, joka mahdollistaa ammatillisen kasvusi. Sinun tukenasi on läsnäoleva lähiesihenkilö ja moniammatillinen työryhmä. Meillä ei tarvitse osata kaikkea heti, vaan me perehdytämme sinut työhön.

Voit lukea lisää Humanassa työskentelystä ja hyvinvaikuttajistamme täältä.

Millaista työkaveria olemme hakemassa?

Odotamme sinulta sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkintoa (lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja).

Arvostamme aikaisempaa kokemusta lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelystä, erityisesti kokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä, lasten ja nuorten psykiatrisesta hoitotyöstä sekä muusta lasten hoito- ja kasvatustyöstä. Myös psykiatrian ja kehitysvammatyön osaamisesta on hyötyä tässä työssä.

Huomioithan, että tehtävään valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote.

Valitulla henkilöllä tulee olla hankittuna sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattikortti työsuhteen alkaessa. Ei koske henkilöitä, joiden tehtävissä ei edellytetä ammattihenkilörekisteriin rekisteröitymistä (Terhikki, Suosikki).

Miksi töihin Humanalle?

Meillä on jokaisella työntekijällä mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhönsä ja hyödyntää omia vahvuuksia työssä. Työvuorosuunnittelussa huomioimme jokaisen henkilökohtaisia tarpeita ja pyrimme hyvällä työvuorosuunnittelulla mahdollistamaan työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamisen sekä hyvän palautumisen työstä.

Haluamme olla työryhmänä aidosti asiakkaitamme varten ja rakentaa yhdessä toimivaa arkea, missä on hyvä ja turvallinen olla.

Henkilöstön hyvinvointia tuemme muun muassa tarjoamalla:

  • Humanan työntekijänä olet oikeutettu kattavaan työterveyshuoltoon.

  • Humanasta saat itsellesi arvovastuullisen työnantajan. Uskomme vahvasti mahdollisuuksiimme hyvinvaikuttaa ihmisiin ja yhteiskuntaan. Olemme ylpeitä arvoistamme: sitoutuminen, vastuullisuus sekä kohtaaminen ja ilo.

Lue lisää eduistamme täältä.

Kiinnostuitko? Seuraavaksi olisi hienoa kuulla sinusta

Tartu tilaisuuteen ja hae helposti verkkosivuillamme viimeistään 20.9.2026 Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajan puitteissa, ja valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Metsätähden yksikönjohtaja Nina-Maria Nieminen p. 0440784442 tai nina-maria.nieminen@humana.fi

Huomioithan, että tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse. Jätä oma hakemuksesi suoraan hakulinkkimme kautta.

Humana on johtava pohjoismainen sosiaalialan toimija, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä sosiaalipalveluita lähellä ihmistä ja perheen arkea. Meitä on Suomessa 2 300. Autamme ja tuemme 5 000 ihmistä erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa. Visiomme mukaisesti uskomme siihen, että jokaisella on oikeus hyvään elämään - ja tätä visiota toteutamme hyvinvaikuttamalla ihmisiin ja yhteiskuntaan.

CACI is seeking an experienced Data Pipeline Engineer, Senior to support enterprise data integration andlogisticsinformation management across the Indo-Pacific. Reporting directly to the Data Architecture Lead, this position ensures operational data from multiple Government and commercial systems is reliably collected, transformed, integrated, and delivered to support real-timelogisticsvisibility and mission execution.

The Data Pipeline Engineer works closely with Government stakeholders, database administrators, data architects, software developers, systems engineers, cybersecurity personnel,logisticsanalysts, business intelligence specialists, and mission partners to develop automated data integration solutions that improve data quality, interoperability, and analytics capabilities. This position contributes to successful program execution by enabling trusted,timely, and actionable data supporting Joint and Special Operations missions throughout the Indo-Pacific theater.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, implement, andmaintainsecure enterprise data pipelines supportinglogisticsand mission support operations.
  • Develop Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL/ELT) processes integrating data from Government and commercial information systems.
  • Design automated workflows supporting data ingestion, transformation, validation, synchronization, and delivery.
  • Integrate data fromlogisticssystems, asset visibility platforms, transportation management systems, enterprise databases, cloud environments, and operational applications.
  • Develop data quality rules, validation procedures, monitoring processes, and error handling capabilities to ensure data integrity.

  • Support cloud migration initiatives, enterprise modernization efforts, and digital transformation projects.
  • Ensure compliance with Government cybersecurity policies, database management standards, data governance requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Support operational exercises, contingency operations, and emergent mission requirements requiring rapid data integration capabilities.
  • Mentor junior database and integration personnel while promoting database engineering best practices and continuous process improvement.
  • Promote scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise data architectures supporting geographically dispersed operations.

Required:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience supporting database administration, data engineering, ETL development, systems integration, enterprise data management, or information technology engineering for Government or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, Joint, Combatant Command, Service Component, Special Operations organizations, or Intelligence Community activities.
  • Experience designing andmaintainingenterprise data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or large-scale database integration solutions.
  • Experience integrating structured and unstructured data from multiple enterprise systems and cloud environments.

title: Extrajobb som chaufför till ICA - Kungsängen
description:
Vi söker nu chaufförer till ICA:s e-handelsverksamhet i Kungsängen. Som chaufför ansvarar du för att leverera matkassar och varor från lagret i Kungsängen till kunder runt om i Stockholm. Du kör lätt lastbil och använder GPS som stöd för att hitta rätt adresser.

Om tjänsten

Arbetet innebär att:

  • Leverera kunders beställningar på ett säkert och professionellt sätt.

  • Lasta och lossa varor.

  • Ge god service vid leverans.

  • Hantera leveranser med noggrannhet och ansvar.

Detta är ett fysiskt aktivt arbete där tunga lyft och trappgång kan förekomma vid leveranser till kunder.

Innan anställning genomförs ett körtest för att säkerställa att du är lämplig för rollen.

Arbetstider och lön

Arbetstiderna är främst förlagda till vardagar och dagtid. Du lägger själv in din tillgänglighet vecka för vecka och förväntas kunna arbeta cirka 3 pass per vecka. Start för tjänsten är omgående och löpande under hösten med en veckas betald obligatorisk utbildning.

Tjänsten omfattas av GFL-lön(genomsnittligt förtjänsteläge). Det innebär att du som inhyrd har samma genomsnittliga lön som jämförbara anställda hos kundföretaget, i enlighet med principen lika lön för lika arbete.

Vi söker:

Du ska trivas i ett aktivt arbete där du är i rörelse under större delen av arbetsdagen. Du tycker om att köra bil och känner dig bekväm med att ta eget ansvar ute på vägarna. Eftersom du är företagets ansikte utåt hos kunderna är det viktigt att du har en god servicekänsla, ett trevligt bemötande och förstår vikten av att skapa en positiv kundupplevelse. Vi tror även att du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och arbetar strukturerat för att säkerställa att leveranserna sker på ett säkert och korrekt sätt.

Krav

  • B-körkort i minst ett år

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

  • Annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50 %, exempelvis studier, annat arbete, eget företag eller elitidrott.

Meriterande

  • God körvana.

  • Erfarenhet av att köra lätt lastbil.

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av distributionskörning, bud- eller transportarbete.

Om du går vidare till nästa steg i vår rekryteringsprocess kommer du att bli uppringd av en AI som genomför en kortare telefonintervju. AI-intervjun är en del av vår urvalsprocess och ger dig möjlighet att besvara några frågor om dig själv och din erfarenhet.

OM JOB&TALENT

Job&Talent är en global innovatör som med hjälp av AI och smart teknik förändrar bemanningsbranschen i grunden. Vi gör det enklare för företag att hitta rätt personal och för människor att hitta rätt arbetsgivare – snabbt, transparent och tillgängligt för alla. Vårt mål är att stärka människorna som får världen att fungera, och med vår moderna plattform skapar vi framtidens arbetsmarknad. Bara under det senaste året hjälpte vi över 300 000 personer till jobb hos mer än 3 200 företag världen över – inom allt från logistik, butik, transport och tjänstemän. Med starka investerare som Atomico, Goldman Sachs, Kinnevik, BlackRock och SoftBank i ryggen växer vi snabbt. Och vi har bara börjat.

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.

title: Senior Engineer - Backend data
description:
About Target

Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company, and one of America’s leading retailers.

Target as a tech company? Absolutely. We are the behind-the-scenes powerhouse that fuels Target’s passion and commitment to cutting-edge innovation. Our teams build and operate the technology that powers every part of Target’s digital and store experience. Our high-performing teams balance independence with collaboration, and we pride ourselves on being versatile, agile, and creative. We are committed to building technology that operates smoothly, securely, and reliably while continuously exploring new ways to solve complex business problems.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale data platforms and pipelines that support critical business and analytical use cases. You will work across the full data lifecycle, from data ingestion and transformation to storage, processing, quality, and consumption.

You will apply strong expertise in Big Data, Apache Spark, Scala, and Google BigQuery to build high-performance, scalable, and reliable data solutions. You will work closely with engineers, architects, product teams, data scientists, and business partners to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with a passion for solving complex problems, optimizing large-scale workloads, and continuously learning emerging technologies. Experience with Java/Spring Boot and exposure to AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude will be an added advantage.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing frameworks using Spark, Scala, BigQuery, and other Big Data technologies.
  • Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for high-volume and complex datasets.
  • Develop efficient data models and optimize BigQuery tables using appropriate partitioning, clustering, query design, and storage strategies.
  • Design and implement scalable batch and distributed data processing solutions using Apache Spark.
  • Develop reusable frameworks and components to improve engineering productivity, data processing efficiency, and operational reliability.
  • Analyze and optimize large-scale data workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost efficiency.
  • Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability across data pipelines and datasets.
  • Troubleshoot complex data, pipeline, infrastructure, and production issues and drive root-cause resolution.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to technical decisions involving data platforms and cloud technologies.
  • Collaborate with Product, Analytics, Data Science, Architecture, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality data products.
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, testing, debugging, and production support activities.
  • Follow engineering best practices around CI/CD, automation, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that improve data engineering productivity and platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and knowledge-sharing across the team.
  • Explore and adopt AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and similar solutions to improve developer productivity and engineering efficiency.
  • Identify practical opportunities to leverage Generative AI for code development, code reviews, debugging, documentation, data analysis, and automation.
  • Stay current with emerging AI and data engineering technologies and evaluate their applicability to Target's technology ecosystem.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software or data engineering, with significant experience building and supporting large-scale data platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:Apache Spark
  • Scala
  • Google BigQuery
  • Big Data / Distributed Processing
  • Data Warehousing
  • ETL/ELT
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Experience designing and optimizing data pipelines for high-volume, high-performance processing.
  • Strong understanding of distributed computing concepts, data partitioning, joins, aggregation, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Good understanding of data modeling, including fact/dimension models and analytical data structures.
  • Experience with data quality, monitoring, observability, and production support.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Ability to participate in architecture discussions and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

  • Java and Spring Boot experience.
  • Experience building REST APIs or microservices.
  • Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and GCP services.
  • Experience with Python and Shell scripting.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker.
  • Experience with data quality platforms such as Monte Carlo or equivalent.
  • Exposure to Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools.
  • Experience developing or contributing to reusable data engineering frameworks.
  • Experience in Retail, AdTech, Media, Analytics, or other high-volume data domains is a plus.

title: 3 x Health & Safety Adviser – Science and Engineering  – 12-month fixed term

We are looking for three Health & Safety Advisers to join our Science and Engineering faculties at the University of Auckland:

  • One Health & Safety Adviser - Medical and Health Sciences
  • One Health & Safety Adviser – Engineering

This is much more than a compliance role. You will be a trusted adviser who understands the needs of the business, provides practical advice, challenges when required, and helps people find solutions that enable teaching and research to happen safely.

  • Supporting compliance with relevant legislation, standards, and University requirements.

This is a full-time (37.5 hours per week), 12-month fixed-term position.

The salary range is $87,000 to $118,00 per annum, depending on skills and experience.

For more detailed information, please refer to the Position Description

He kōrero mōu | About you

We are looking for someone who combines sound technical health and safety knowledge with strong interpersonal skills and a practical, people-focused approach.

You will bring:

  • A relevant tertiary qualification and demonstrated experience in health and safety, preferably within a complex, technical or higher-risk environment.
  • For the Science positions: a degree in Science, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety or a related discipline. A Chemistry qualification or background would be advantageous.
  • For the Engineering position: a degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 3–4 years’ relevant health and safety experience, ideally within a complex operational, laboratory, research, engineering, or other technical environment
  • Strong knowledge of risk management, hazard identification, incident management and health and safety compliance.
  • Experience supporting incident investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement, as well as developing, reviewing and maintaining risk assessments, procedures and health and safety documentation.
  • Experience undertaking audits, inspections, safety walks and other assurance activities, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple compliance and administrative requirements.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building and influencing skills, with the confidence to work with people at all levels, challenge constructively, provide appropriate pushback and build practical, solutions-focused relationships.
  • The ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership, supported by strong organisational and administrative skills,
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using large or complex health and safety management systems - Sidetrack and/or Ideagen (previously Damstra) would be advantageous.

If you have a background in science, engineering, manufacturing or laboratory environments, and a passion for health, safety and wellbeing, we’d love to hear from you.

Ngā āhuatanga kei a mātou | What we offer

The University of Auckland is New Zealand’s leading university and maintains significant computational, laboratory, and analytic facilities. Auckland itself is frequently rated as one of the world’s most liveable cities.

The University is committed to providing an excellent working environment through:

  • Flexible employment practices (including working from home, flexible hours)

In addition, we also offer career development programmes, discounted car parking, a generous parental leave allowance, childcare, and several other discounts on internal and external services.

title: Tech_MID_PT
description:
About the company

Albertsons Companies is at the forefront of the revolution in retail. With a fixation on raising the bar with innovation and building belonging through our culture, our team is rallying our company around a unique purpose: to create joy around each table and inspire a healthier tomorrow for every community.

Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with over 2,200 stores in 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners include Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw's, Acme, Tom Thumb, Randalls, United Supermarkets, Pavilions, Star Market, Haggen, Carr’s, Kings Food Markets, and Balducci's Food Lovers Market. We support our stores with 22 distribution centers and 19 manufacturing plants.

Bring your flavor

Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.

What you will be doing

The Pharmacy Technician at the Central Fulfillment Center is responsible for working in a closed-door, fast-paced pharmacy facility on a production line. They are responsible for filling prescriptions under the direct supervision of a pharmacist. The Pharmacy Technician will work with prescription filling automation technologies and semi-manual/manual workstations to ensure the accuracy and completeness of orders and maintain a continuous and consistent workflow to help meet team goals.

The position is based in Irving, TX. We are looking for a full-time pharmacy technician to work in the morning shift.

  • Mondays and Wednesdays: 9:30AM to 6:00PM
  • Saturday: 7:00AM to 3:30PM

Main responsibilities

  • Follow and promote proper Pharmacy, general safety, and security procedures and processes of the company.

  • Use scanning and counting technologies to identify and select appropriate pharmaceutical products and quantities for filling prescription orders.

  • Ensuring medication counting devices are continuously replenished.

  • Assist with maintaining the pharmacy system and technologies that facilitate proper counting, conveyance, packaging, and shipping of prescriptions.

  • Monitoring inventory and supply levels at the responsible stations, calibrating machines, general troubleshooting (jams, blockages) within conveyance, counting, and packaging machines, escalating technical issues, and working as a team to reach team goals.

  • Monitoring and maintaining uptime of automated counting, collating, packaging, and sorting devices, ensuring continuous operation through basic troubleshooting of routine errors.

  • Create and maintain documentation as requested.

  • Manually fill prescriptions as needed.

  • Verify attributes of the product such as: size, strength, quantity, etc. before processing orders. Enter or scan expiration date and lot numbers.

  • Ensure labels on prescriptions are correct.

  • Prepare packages, sort, and manifest prescription orders if needed.

  • Stock and rotate merchandise and supplies to limit shrinkage if needed.

  • Assist Inventory Technicians as requested. Participate in Inventory Audits as needed.

  • Other duties as assigned concurrent with all applicable laws and regulations.

What we are searching for

  • Must be committed to contributing to a culture of safety, looking out for yourself and others.

  • Must be committed to achieving optimal productivity and efficiency and be self-motivated, energetic, and detail oriented.

  • Acts as a highly organized, flexible, adaptable subject matter expert who can prioritize.

  • Works well with others and can motivate people you work with. Able to be a role model and lead by example.

  • Good communication skills both written and verbal.

  • Professional image with proper grooming.

  • Must have a willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours as needed.

We believe the successful candidate has these qualifications and experience

  • Required:

    • Pharmacy Technician License in Texas.

    • Ability to preserve confidentiality of patient information.

  • Preferred:

    • A national Pharmacy Technician Certification.

  • Technical Experience:

    • Central Fulfillment Pharmacy Technician experience.

    • Prefers to work in a closed-door environment (no adjudication, customer interaction, phone work.)

    • Good computer skills.

    • Good math skills.

Physical Requirements

  • Willing and able to stand/walk at least 8 hours with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Willing and able to perform tasks which include pushing, pulling, grasping, bending, stooping, rotating, reaching, and lifting/carrying up to 40 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Visual focus such as counting, observing, etc. is required consistently.

  • Performing repetitive tasks up to 100% of the time

Our 290,000 associates have a passion for great service and building lasting relationships with our customers. Through a companywide focus on innovation, we are continually enhancing our digital and product offerings, making it easy for customers to get what they need, wherever they are.

title: Sr. Program Manager
description:
Manage Breakthrough Product Development Programs from Concept to Launch

Fieldpiece is the innovation leader in professional HVACR test instruments, trusted by technicians around the world to solve some of the industry's toughest challenges. We're investing heavily in the future of product development through modern Fast Time To Market (FTTM) methodologies, connected products, AI-enabled engineering, and customer-centered innovation. Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers.

Why This Role?

Great products don't happen by accident - they happen because exceptional leaders bring people, ideas, and execution together.

As our Senior Program Manager, you'll lead some of Fieldpiece's most strategic new product initiatives while helping transform how we develop products. You'll work across Engineering, Product Management, Industrial Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and global development partners to align teams, remove obstacles, and deliver innovative connected products.

Beyond delivering successful programs, you'll play a key role in advancing our FTTM methodology, helping us continuously improve how we innovate, collaborate, and bring products to market. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, influencing without authority, and turning ambitious ideas into reality, you'll thrive in this role.

This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028. This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.

What You'll Do

  • Lead multiple, complex new product development programs from concept through commercial launch that include hardware, firmware, and software.
  • Align cross-functional teams across Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, Quality, Operations, and Manufacturing.
  • Drive program planning, risk management, executive communication, and decision-making.
  • Coordinate global development activities with suppliers and strategic partners.
  • Champion Fast Time To Market (FTTM) methodologies and continuous improvement.
  • Help build a culture of accountability, transparency, and excellence in execution.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • You'll help redefine how an entire company develops products while bringing innovative connected technologies to market faster than ever before.
  • Shape the future of product development at an innovation-driven company building the next-generation of connected HVACR products by applying FTTM methodologies to accelerate innovation.
  • Influence both what we build to solve real customer problems and how we build them.
  • Help drive the adoption of AI-enabled engineering, connected products, and technician productivity solutions in collaboration with global engineering organizations and strategic technology partners.

In Your First Year, You'll Likely Have:

  • Successfully lead multiple new product development programs through key development milestones.
  • Become a trusted cross-functional leader who helps teams make better, faster decisions.
  • Embedded FTTM best practices into day-to-day program execution.
  • Built strong relationships with internal teams and strategic external partners.
  • Improved program visibility, risk management, and execution predictability.

  • U nas zawsze dużo się dzieje – i to jest super! - Nasze sklepy tętnią życiem. Nie ma miejsca na nudę, a każdy dzień przynosi coś nowego.

  • Wyjazdy z misją: program “Bolster” - Możesz brać udział w otwarciach nowych sklepów Primark i wspierać swoim doświadczeniem zespoły w całym regionie Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej (Polska, Czechy, Słowacja, Rumunia, Węgry, Słowenia).

  • Stała zniżka pracownicza - Wykorzystasz ją we wszystkich sklepach Primark w Polsce.
  • Komfortowe miejsce pracy - Szatnie z prysznicem, strefa relaksu z automatami z kawą i przekąskami, bezpłatny dostęp do wifi i komputera.
  • Zrównoważony grafik - Grafiki ustalamy z wyprzedzeniem i staramy się uwzględniać Twoje potrzeby związane z nauką, studiami czy inną pracą.

To rola szyta na miarę dla Ciebie, jeśli chcesz:

  • Dbać o obsługę klienta na sali sprzedaży, kasach oraz przymierzalniach - i sprawiać, by ludzie się uśmiechali.
  • Zapewniać niesamowite wrażenia z wizyty w sklepie, doradzając Klient(k)om w wyborze odpowiedniego rozmiaru czy udzielając informacji o produktach.
  • Przyjmować dostawy oraz dbać o odpowiednią ekspozycję produktów i estetyczny wygląd sklepu.
  • Mieć wpływ na to, co sprzedajemy, wspierając managerów w przygotowywaniu zamówień produktów.

Ponieważ jesteś niepowtarzalny(-a)
Cenimy różnorodność i wiemy, że każdy i każda z nas wnosi swój niepowtarzalny styl i charakter do naszych sklepów. Dlatego nie ma jednego typu osoby, która idealnie sprawdzi się w Primark.

Pasujesz do nas, jeśli:

  • Lubisz, gdy zawsze coś się dzieje i preferujesz pracę w szybkim tempie.
  • Jesteś pozytywnie nastawiony(-a) i lubisz uczyć się nowych rzeczy.

  • Cechuje Cię zaangażowanie i dokładność.
  • Jesteś osobą pełnoletnią oraz dyspozycyjną do pracy w systemie zmianowym oraz w weekendy.

Niezależnie od tego, czy masz już doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta, czy też dopiero zaczynasz swoją drogę zawodową – u nas jesteś mile widziany(-a). Dla nas liczy się Twoja otwartość i zaangażowanie.

Jesteśmy otwarci na wszystkich – zapraszamy również osoby z niepełnosprawnością, jak i w wieku 50+. APLIKUJ TERAZ

Nie czekaj – dołącz do nas i znajdź swoje miejsce! :)

  • Spotkanie rekrutacyjne Ostatnim etapem jest 30‑minutowa rozmowa z managerem(-ką).
  • Informacja zwrotna Po zakończeniu procesu zawsze wracamy z informacją zwrotną - niezależnie od wyniku rekrutacji.

title: Laundry Supervisor - THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride - OKC
description:
Job Title: Laundry Supervisor

Division/Department: Rail Events Production/Run Crew

Reports To: Production Wardrobe Supervisor /Production Management

Type of position: Non-Exempt/Hourly

Employee Classification: Seasonal

Compensation: $18-$23

Job Summary: The Laundry Supervisor works with the Production Wardrobe Supervisor, along with local department supervisors and on-site management during the run of the show to maintain laundered items. They oversee the care of costumes, linens, and other textiles, ensuring they are clean, dry, and properly stored. This role involves inspecting and making minor repairs to costumes, operating laundry equipment including irons and steamers, sorting items, handling stains, and maintaining the overall cleanliness of laundered pieces. They work under the supervision of the Production Wardrobe Supervisor, Production Managers, and Stage Managers. Because of the nature of the live event, they may be required to assist in any event related items as required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Work with the production team to ensure laundry needs are met for Wardrobe, Catering, Props/Decor, and Front of House.
  • Assist Wardrobe team with load in and organization of all wardrobe supplies.
  • Responsible for daily laundry and stain removal.
  • Help maintain costume quality by inspecting and overseeing minor repairs to costume pieces.
  • Sort laundry by department, fabric type, color,and washing instructions, and pre-treat stains before washing.
  • Operate washing machines, dryers, or other equipment, following safety guidelines and manufacturer instructions.
  • Laundry attendants load and unload laundry machines, adjust settings, and monitor cycles to ensure items are properly cleaned and dried.
  • Track laundry supplies and notify supervisors when replenishment is needed.
  • Work with the production staff during load out to see that the event space is returned to the railroad appropriately.
  • Become familiar with company policies regarding safety.
  • Work with the entire event team to maintain a positive, enjoyable, and rewarding environment for all staff and passengers.
  • Other duties as assigned

Education, Skills, Work Experience Requirements:

  • Experience as a laundry attendant, wardrobe supervisor and/or seamstress/tailor
  • This role requires attention to detail to ensure items are properly sorted, cleaned, and cared for
  • Understanding different fabrics, stain removal techniques, and laundry equipment operation
  • Demonstrate ability to anticipate, recognize and solve practical problems and resolve issues
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in written form
  • Experience sewing (hand stitching and machine) and general clothing repair and maintenance
  • Have good DIY, and repair skills
  • Strong organizational, time management, and communication skills
  • Ability to work alongside the production staff as a team member in an ever-changing environment to meet laundry needs
  • Ability to work independently with self-motivation as well as excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Commitment to working with shared leadership and in cross-functional teams that can include seasonal employees and interns

Work Environment:

  • Fast-paced work environment
  • Frequent long intervals of walking, standing, bending, and lifting
  • Domestic travel
  • Evening and weekend work

What’s in it for you?

  • Serve others and create a world of make-believe and magic
  • Great industry pay and a chance to build upon your theater network and make lifelong connections
  • Enrich and positively impact the holiday experience for all – big and small
  • Be part of an inclusive team in a supportive environment with high expectations for self and your fellow teammates

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Ready to become part of the dynamic Tech One Global team?

We’re looking for passionate individuals with the right skills and drive to join us on our journey of digital transformation.

About Tech One

With over two decades of industry leadership and operations across Asia, Tech One Global is a multi‑awarded AI and Digital Transformation Partner. We have delivered more than 2,000 cloud projects, supported various clients, and empowered organizations with solutions in Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud Infrastructure, Digital & App Innovation, and ERP.

In the Philippines, Tech One Global has been recognized as one of the Best Workplaces 2024, a testament to our culture of innovation, empathy, and growth. Our people are at the heart of everything we do: smart, passionate, and dedicated to building impactful digital solutions that help businesses thrive in a rapidly evolving world.

Our Purpose

At Tech One, we lead, inspire, motivate, and empower businesses in their digital evolution. We believe technology is not just about systems; it’s about enabling people and communities to achieve remarkable results.

Our Team

You’ll work with a diverse, global team of innovators who thrive in a fast‑paced environment where ideas move quickly from design to deployment. Collaboration, continuous learning, and growth are part of our DNA. As we continue to scale, you’ll find opportunities to expand your expertise, take on larger projects, and grow into leadership roles, backed by competitive rewards and a culture that listens.

About the Role:

As a DevOps Engineer, you will improve how we build, release, and operate software in production. You will design and run secure CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code, and ensure our platforms are observable, reliable, and cost‑efficient. You will partner closely with engineers to reduce lead time to production and improve system stability.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable safe, fast delivery, including automated testing, quality gates, and deployment controls.
  • Automate provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred; ARM templates acceptable depending on platform needs).
  • Operate and improve container platforms (Kubernetes), including deployments, scaling, configuration, and runtime troubleshooting.
  • Implement GitOps and release practices (versioning, promotion across environments, rollback strategies, and change control).
  • Improve platform reliability through incident response, root cause analysis, and preventive automation
  • Implement and maintain security and compliance controls across build and runtime (secrets management, least privilege, image scanning, policy enforcement).
  • Build observability for services and infrastructure: metrics, alerting, dashboards, and performance tuning using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and extend into logs/traces as needed.
  • Partner with development teams to improve engineering workflows, reliability standards, and documentation.

Here’s what you’ll need:

  • Core Expertise: Expert proficiency in DevOps with at least 3 years of experience in DevOps roles
  • Methodologies: Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and modern software delivery approaches
  • Cloud & Containerization: Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms, plus Docker and Kubernetes
  • Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) to automate processes
  • Problem‑Solving: Ability to troubleshoot and resolve application issues effectively
  • Good‑to‑Have Skills (any of the following):
    • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Ansible, Helm, ArgoCD, Openshift
    • CI/CD & Version Control: Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bamboo
    • Monitoring & Quality: Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Sonarqube, Artifactory/JFrog
    • Collaboration Tools: Jira, Confluence, Atlassian suite
    • Cloud DevOps: AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeCommit

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive Rewards & Benefits: Performance bonuses, 13th month pay, and Day 1 HMO and life insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexibility & Balance: Hybrid work arrangements, flexible schedules, and expanded maternity and paternity leave
  • Growth & Development: Company‑sponsored trainings, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities
  • Recognition & Culture: Be part of a workplace recognized as one of the Philippines’ Best Workplaces 2024, where your contributions are valued and your voice is heard
  • Community & Belonging: A culture of inclusion, diversity, and empathy, with loyalty rewards, holiday gifts, and programs that celebrate milestones and people

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

All employment decisions at Tech One Global shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, or any other basis protected by law.

Are you a proven cybersecurity services seller with deep expertise in Zero Trust, cloud security, managed detection and response (MDR), security operations, managed security services (MSS), or enterprise security transformation? Do you have experience guiding enterprise clients through complex security decisions, helping them architect, implement, manage, and secure their critical infrastructure? Now is the time to bring your cybersecurity expertise to a consulting sales role for a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator where success and fulfillment go hand in hand. You will be at the forefront of helping enterprises transform their security posture, strengthen their resilience, achieve compliance objectives, and optimize their security operations in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

The Opportunity
As a Market Development Executive with Insight, you will be the catalyst for identifying new cybersecurity and security services opportunities within our existing enterprise client base. We will count on you to introduce customized security consulting, implementation, managed services, and managed security services solutions to large enterprise clients across a spectrum of industries. You will manage the sales process from the initial security assessment, through solution design, to the final close. Along the way, you will leverage Insight's unique services expertise to provide everything our clients need to progress in one place: a creative vision, executional capabilities, and ongoing solutions management.

Previous enterprise cybersecurity sales experience is required; however, we will consider cloud security, infrastructure security, and application security experience as added benefits.

Qualifications and Responsibilities
We're seeking experienced technical and sales executives with a track record of strategizing & operationalizing cybersecurity and managed security services solutions to solve critical business problems. You should also have a bachelor's degree in business, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field and experience driving enterprise security sales.

Significant Cybersecurity & Managed Security Services Sales Experience
You are known as a trusted advisor to clients in how to deploy enterprise security solutions and have extensive experience in cybersecurity consulting services and managed security services: Zero Trust architecture, managed detection and response (MDR), security operations center (SOC) design and implementation, managed security services (MSS) operations and optimization, cloud security, application security, threat and vulnerability management, and/or security compliance and governance. Your track record in 'hunting' and 'farming' accounts, including new areas of an existing client with cybersecurity consulting and managed security services, will distinguish you as a meaningful addition to the account team. Your skills in multi-stakeholder engagement (CISO, CIO, Security Architects, Board-level executives), channel selling, and formal opportunity/account management methods will help you build a deep and varied set of opportunities. Your proven experience to forge new security vendor partnerships and your ability to quickly build trust with security vendor counterparties will establish new and consistent pipeline opportunities.

Managed Security Services Expertise
You bring hands-on knowledge of managed security services delivery models, including 24/7 monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and security operations optimization. You understand the operational and financial benefits of MSS to enterprise clients, including cost predictability, access to specialized talent, and improved security posture. You can articulate the value of transitioning from reactive security to proactive, managed security operations, and you have experience positioning MSS alongside traditional consulting and implementation services to create comprehensive security transformation programs.

Client Engagement Skills
You share our goal to make meaningful connections each day that positively impact the lives of the people we serve, including our clients, partners, and teammates. You build strong customer relationships with executive-level decision-makers (CISOs, CIOs, security leaders) around their security posture and operational efficiency, providing trusted advisory services to assist them in achieving their security transformation, compliance objectives, and security operations excellence.

Deep Technical Expertise
Your success in this role depends on your ability to help C-Suite & security leaders understand where their security posture sits within their broader IT and cloud infrastructure, and how managed security services can enhance their operational capabilities. Your knowledge of cybersecurity solutions, managed security services delivery, threat landscapes, and compliance requirements allows you to roadmap ideas and turn security challenges into transformation opportunities. Five years minimum of current and proven end-to-end security solutions sales experience. Preferred candidates will have five years minimum of enterprise cybersecurity services sales experience with numerous case study examples of leading complex security transformation deals, including managed security services implementations.

Growth Mindset
Your experience leading large security transformation initiatives as a security principal or consulting services specialist gives you an eye for whitespace within existing accounts. You see new opportunities for specialty security solutions, managed services, and operational improvements; execute technical account growth strategy in partnership with services delivery; and drive efficiency through automation and analytics. You embody our values: Hunger, Heart, and Harmony.

What you can expect

  • Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Ben jij een dynamische HR-professional met de ambitie om de employee experience van Vattenfall naar een hoger niveau te tillen?

People Services Delivery NL is op zoek naar een HR Specialist.

Deze positie biedt een mooie kans voor een ambitieuze professional met relevante kennis en ervaring, die een 2e/3e stap wil maken en verder wil groeien in onze (internationale) HR-organisatie.

People Services NL is verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen en begeleiden van HR Direct team (HR operations team) en is de linking pin naar Vattenfall stakeholders, zoals: medewerkers, Group Compensation & Benefits, Industrial Relations en de HR business partners in Nederland. Het doel van People Services NL is het aanbieden van een sterke kwaliteit van HR-services. Daarom zijn continue verbetering van de services en een sterke focus op employee experience constante drijfveren in ons dagelijks werk.

Als HR Specialist ga je werken in een internationale setting, dus denken in een grensoverschrijdende context is belangrijk. De stakeholders bevinden zich met name in Nederland. Ons jonge en gedreven team is na een eerdere periode van outsourcing weer nieuw opgebouwd binnen de organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?
Als HR Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat de HR-processen worden uitgevoerd en verbeterd. Je gaat kijken hoe we, met behulpt van AI, onze processen makkelijker kunt maken voor onze medewerkers. Samen met HR Direct zorg jij ervoor dat de administratieve afhandeling en het coördineren van HR processen rondom, met name maar niet gelimiteerd tot tijd en verlof uitstekend verloopt. Je hebt een scherp oog voor kwaliteit, communicatie en een hoog serviceniveau.

Je rapporteert aan de Director People Service NL. Je werkt nauw samen met de Process Manager en een team van HR specialisten, inzetbaar op verschillende processen en projecten met ieder hun eigen specialiteit en het HR Direct team in Nederland. Buiten het team heb je veel contact met de specialisten van Compensation & Benefits, Industrial Relations, HRIT en HR-leveranciers.

Belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Single point of contact interne HR administratie en payroll collega’s voor de verschillende administratieve processen binnen HR operations.
  • Voorzitten en begeleiden van de operationele meetings met de HR direct
  • Afstemmen met de procesmanager, specialisten en het support team om een ​​sterke en geïntegreerde kwaliteit van levering te garanderen
  • Linking pin naar Vattenfall P&C business partners voor de processen in scope
  • Zorgen voor een adequate ticketafhandeling door HR Direct voor de processen in scope, met een verdieping in time and leave en AI
  • Continue verbeteringen bedenken en de ruimte zoeken om die samen met HR Direct uit te voeren
  • Coördineren of ondersteunen bij change requests of escalaties vanuit business of HR Direct
  • Verzorgen van proactieve en reactieve inhoudelijke expertise en advies op jouw vakgebied aan interne collega's en HR Direct.

Locatie:
Amsterdam

Wie ben jij?
Als persoon ben je in staat om om te gaan met verandering en soms hoge werkdruk. Je bent oplossingsgericht. Je hebt de vaardigheden en het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen, te organiseren en realistisch en efficiënt te plannen. Met een strategische en analytische focus vertaal je soms complexe zaken in eenvoudige en helder te begrijpen processen en werkinstructies.

Je begrijpt de verschillende belangen van al je stakeholders en weet deze in balans te brengen met een servicegerichte en gestandaardiseerde manier van werken.

Daarnaast voldoe je aan de volgende eisen en kwalificaties:

  • Bachelor of Master diploma in een relevant vakgebied (bij voorkeur HR)
  • Minimaal 2-3 jaar ervaring in een relevante HR-omgeving (bijv. in HR/ People Services)
  • Kennis en ervaring van de processen in scope (bijv. verlofregistratie)
  • Analytisch denkvermogen en ervaring met projectmanagement
  • Ervaring in een internationale HR-omgeving
  • Bewezen coördinerende vaardigheden en het vermogen om te leiden
  • Heldere en gestructureerde communicatie in zowel Nederlands als Engels
  • Goed gevoel voor samenwerken en oplossingsgerichte mentaliteit
  • Proactieve, enthousiaste en servicegerichte instelling, altijd op zoek naar een weg vooruit

Wij bieden

De hoogte van jouw salaris wordt gebaseerd op je opleiding en je relevante werkervaring. Het salaris voor deze functie is €4.750,- tot €5.800,- bruto per maand, exclusief vakantiegeld, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Naast je salaris kennen we een goed secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket waarvan de belangrijkste onderdelen zijn:

  • Op basis van je jaarsalaris ontvang je 8% vakantiegeld, een eindejaarsuitkering van 4,5% en een winstdeling tot 3,5% van je jaarsalaris op basis van de resultaten van Vattenfall Nederland (RDR)
  • NS Business kaart voor woon/werk verkeer of reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per km (max. 50 km enkele reis) en een thuiswerkvergoeding van €3,05
  • 20 vakantiedagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen (onderdeel van Mijn Keuze Mijn Budget)
  • 2 bovenwettelijke dagen ter compensatie voor overwerken, vanaf schaal 9 (onderdeel van Mijn Keuze Mijn Budget)
  • 3,5 vitaliteitsdagen en 13 ADV-dagen (bij 38-uur contract met 40-urige werkweek)
  • Mijn Budget Mijn Keuze: extra vakantiedagen aan- en verkopen, een fiets aanschaffen of je kan je budget (maandelijks) laten uitbetalen
  • Pensioen bij ABP: Vattenfall draagt 70% bij en jij 30%.
  • Zorgverzekering Collectiviteitskorting bij Zilveren Kruis Achmea
  • 4 verlofuren om vrijwilligerswerk via Vattenfall Foundation te verrichten
  • Opleidingsbudget voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij Vattenfall heerst een hechte teamcultuur waar tegelijkertijd volop ruimte is voor eigen initiatief.

Hybride werken is bij ons de de norm, wat betekent dat je in ieder geval 50% op kantoor werkt. De meeste van jouw collega’s werken graag de overige 50% van hun tijd thuis, maar dat laten we volledig aan jou. We hechten bij Vattenfall veel waarde aan een goede werk-privé balans en wij blijven kijken hoe wij hier als werkgever aan bij kunnen dragen.

Solliciteren / Meer weten?
Klinkt dit interessant? We zien jouw sollicitatie graag uiterlijk 15 september 2026 tegemoet. Voor vragen over de functie en/of het proces kun je contact opnemen met Joany van Megen, Senior Corporate Recruiter, joany.vanmegen@vattenfall.com.

Bij Vattenfall zijn wij ervan overtuigd dat diversiteit een grote bijdrage levert aan onze organisatie. Daarom streven wij constant naar een harmonieuze balans tussen onze medewerkers op het gebied van leeftijd, seksuele geaardheid, geloofsovertuiging, genderidentiteit, (arbeids)beperking en culturele of etnische achtergrond.

De veiligheid van Vattenfall en haar medewerkers is essentieel. Daarom maakt een pre-employment screening deel uit van het selectieproces. De screening is gebaseerd op de rol die je gaat vervullen binnen Vattenfall. De screening wordt uitgevoerd door een derde partij, DISA Global Solutions AB.

We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

Responsibilities include supervising and developing staff, monitoring budgets and financial performance, supporting fundraising efforts, and ensuring compliance with safety, risk management, and regulatory requirements.


The Associate Executive Director plays a key role in enhancing the member experience and supporting the overall growth and sustainability of the SpartanNash YMCA. This position may involve early morning, evening, weekend, and on-call responsibilities as needed to support branch operations.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


Program Development

title: DOTNET Senior Full Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Development)

  • Build and maintain unit, integration, and automated tests , using AI to expand coverage and reduce reliance on manual QA
  • Apply AI tools in daily development to: generate, refine, and optimize code rapidly increase test coverage in existing systems analyze and understand large or unfamiliar codebases assist in debugging and root cause analysis accelerate documentation and knowledge sharing
  • Break down existing systems into cleaner architectural boundaries where appropriate (API-first, service-oriented design)
  • Contribute to improving development workflows, including CI/CD, automation, and deployment practices
  • Collaborate across teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with C# and .NET (Framework and/or .NET Core/.NET 6+)
  • Experience working in and improving legacy systems
  • Strong experience building RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit and/or integration)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools in software development workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and system analysis skills
  • Experience with SQL Server or similar relational databases

AI-Driven Development Expectations

You are expected to actively use AI tools (e.g., GitHubCopilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to increase speed, improve output quality, and reduce manual effort across the development lifecycle. This includes:

  • Generating and refining code scaffolding, refactors, and repetitive logic
  • Producing unit and integration tests from existing codebases
  • Using AI to quickly understand and navigate legacy systems
  • Accelerating API development, documentation, and integration work
  • Assisting with bug investigation, debugging, and root cause analysis
  • Iterating rapidly by combining engineering judgment with AI-generated output

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating applications from .NET Framework to modern .NET
  • Experience increasing test coverage in low-coverage or untested systems
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure preferred)

What Were Looking For

Engineers who use AI to meaningfully increase productivity and engineering output Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive work to completion Practical problem solvers comfortable working in real-world, imperfect systems Ability to balance speed, quality, and maintainability Clear communicators who collaborate effectively across teams Collaborative team focused on delivering results

Senior Data Engineer - Spark / Kafka / NiFi

Job Posting Title: Senior Data Engineer - Spark / Kafka / NiF

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our culture is guided by the Mastercard Way—own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in distributed systems, streaming architectures, event-driven platforms, and cloud-native data processing. Performance & Scalability

  • Participate in troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and incident resolution activities.

Engineering Excellence

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Architecture, Platform, and DevOps teams.
  • Contribute to CI/CD processes and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • 6+ years of hands-on software deployment, validation, testing, development experience on large-scale data-intensive applications.
  • Strong expertise in Apache Spark (Batch and Structured Streaming).
  • Strong experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience developing, testing and supporting Apache NiFi data flows.
  • Proficiency in Scala, pyspark or Python.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills.
  • Experience working with distributed storage systems such as Apache Ozone, Ceph, HDFS, or cloud-based object stores.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux, Git, shell scripting, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience operating production-grade distributed systems in cloud or hybrid-cloud environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building observability solutions using monitoring and logging platforms.
  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data platform best practices.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of performance engineering, resilience testing, and production readiness assessments.
  • Experience building engineering automation frameworks and reusable validation platforms.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, monitoring systems, and operational analytics.
  • Experience in highly regulated, transaction-processing, or large-scale enterprise environments.

Corporate Security Responsibility

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer / Software Architect to conduct a comprehensive technical audit of several existing software projects. This is not a build-from-scratch role — the initial engagement is focused on reviewing our current codebases, understanding what has been built, identifying strengths and weaknesses, and delivering a clear, professional roadmap for improvement before further development continues. Strong candidates may be considered for a longer-term senior developer or technical lead position based on performance in this initial engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct a complete technical audit of existing frontend (React, Next.js, TypeScript), backend (API architecture, authentication, authorization, business logic), and database (PostgreSQL/Supabase) systems

  • Assess code quality, architecture, security, performance, and scalability across all reviewed projects

  • Identify duplicated, unnecessary, obsolete, or poorly structured code, as well as unfinished or partially implemented features

  • Evaluate database schemas, relationships, indexes, constraints, Row Level Security (RLS) policies, and query performance

  • Review AI integrations where applicable (OpenAI API, LLM integrations, RAG, vector databases, prompt architecture, cost/rate controls)

  • Evaluate infrastructure and DevOps practices, including Git/GitHub structure, CI/CD, environment configuration, deployment, logging, and monitoring

  • Conduct a full security review covering authentication, authorization, API key/secret protection, input validation, and common vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, CSRF)

  • Classify each major system/feature as Good, Needs Improvement, Needs Refactoring, Critical, Incomplete, or Not Implemented

  • Deliver a written technical assessment report covering all required sections (executive summary, architecture, frontend/backend/database/security/performance assessments, technical debt list, prioritized recommendations, and production-readiness scoring)

  • Provide an overall Production Readiness score (out of 100) with a percentage breakdown of completed, needs-improvement, needs-rework, and incomplete/missing components

  • Clearly communicate technical findings to a non-technical founder/business owner

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all proprietary source code and repository access

Requirements and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience

  • Strong full-stack development experience, with particular strength in React, Next.js, and TypeScript

  • Strong PostgreSQL knowledge; Supabase experience highly preferred

  • Experience with API architecture, authentication, and authorization systems

  • Software architecture and security review experience

  • Proven experience auditing or inheriting codebases built by other developers

  • Working knowledge of Git/GitHub, CI/CD, and production deployment environments

  • Experience with AI integrations (OpenAI API, LLM integrations, RAG, vector databases) is a strong advantage

  • Experience with large SaaS platforms, AI applications, marketplaces, or multi-role platforms is a major advantage

  • Ability to produce clear, detailed written technical audit reports

  • Ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical stakeholders

  • Willingness to sign an NDA and comply with confidentiality and secure access protocols.

Working closely with executive leadership, enterprise architects, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will architect, secure, and deliver scalable cloud solutions that directly enhance public health services across Texas.
